name: Technique - Gun body and filter
description: Standalone technique from the machine-gun checklist: Serum wavetable body, retriggered triplet LFO, comb/steep filtering, convolution and tone/length macros.

manual.instruction: Pitch the body down and use a second wavetable. Choose a gnarly table and add a retriggered LFO on triplets.
manual.verify: The body has a short, repeating triplet movement rather than a static tone.
manual.why: Code: Pandorum builds the foundation from a pitched-down second wavetable and a triplet-retriggered LFO.

manual.instruction: Add noise for the click, then use a comb filter and a steep driven low-pass. Automate volume so the body has a defined fall.
manual.verify: The filter adds metallic tone and the hit still falls away quickly.
manual.why: Code: Pandorum combines a comb filter, steep low-pass with drive and volume automation.

manual.instruction: Add convolution and distortion. Cut low end before distortion for definition, or leave some for crackle; make tone and length macros.
manual.verify: The body has a consistent character across several gun variations.
manual.why: Code: Pandorum uses convolution, distortion, and tone/length macros for the chain-gun foundation.

notes: Sources: MOONBOY, 'HOW TO TEAROUT DUBSTEP' (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nApsgDWSQ7Y); Code: Pandorum, 'MACHINE GUN BASS DESIGN' (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sk--QbE_TM0); Wheysted Music, 'SERUM TEAR-OUT GUN BASS TUTORIAL' (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KkXF4T_WPbY); Dripment, '2 TEAROUT Serum 2 BASS ROUTINES' (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NRfK34KZIf8).
